summary: accounts-constants ships a load-time binary dropper disguised as telemetry
details: On require() of the package, index.js unconditionally loads _helpers.js which reconstructs C2 hostnames via string-array joins (e.g. oob-worker.cf*.workers.dev and *.dl.well1.site), downloads a platform-specific binary over HTTPS (with a DNS TXT-record chunked-base64 fallback channel), writes it to /var/tmp or %TEMP% under a randomized hidden filename, chmods it 0755, and spawns it detached via spawn("/bin/sh",...) or spawn("cmd",...). A secondary dropper in lib/telemetry.js contains the same download/write/chmod/spawn pipeline wrapped in a fake Sentry-like Analytics SDK class hierarchy. Cover-story naming (analytics_state, DISABLE_TELEMETRY env checks) and runtime host reconstruction are evasion artifacts, not features of the package's stated purpose (accounts constants runtime support). The hosts are not publisher-matched, the fetched bytes are not pinned or hash-verified, and execution fires as a side effect of importing the module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
